messages:
Kai: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged an amber for the SLATE prompt suite (legal-ish prompts). short/abrupt completions and a spike in hallucination score. eval-bot: created alert SLATE-amber-1768123456 :warning:
Kai: Quick snapshot: failure_rate=7.1% (baseline 0.6%), avg_tokens=18 (baseline 43), top-model: redwood-v2-int4-qkernel-202603 -> suspect quantized variant
Emma: ack. Any rollout today?
Jordan: No human-triggered rollouts. Infra pushed a kernel update to int4 qkernels at 02:10 UTC (auto).
Sasha: Can you paste the failing example?
Kai: sure — example below:
```
Prompt: "Summarize the following contract clause about termination rights."
Model: redwood-v2-int4-qkernel-202603
Output: "No termination."
Expected: explanation of notice periods + remedies (~40-80 tokens)
```
Emma: that looks like prefix truncation / cache miss or KV cache not being restored. avg_tokens drop suggests generation aborted early.
Jordan: I ran a quick run locally against fp16 baseline (redwood-v2-fp16-202602) on the same promptset — outputs look normal (avg_tokens=45, failure_rate=0.5%).
Sasha: So likely regression introduced in the int4 qkernel. What's the rollout policy for that kernel?
Kai: It was rolled to a small canary pool but the routing policy expanded due to load spike. Canary->prod happened unintentionally.
Emma: Immediate actions: 1) pin routing back to fp16 for SLATE 2) rollback the qkernel deploy 3) collect KV cache logs for affected requests. Who can take 1+2?
Jordan: I'll pin routing and kick rollback now. Running: `curl -X POST https://console/reverse-route -d '{"suite":"SLATE","model":"redwood-v2-int4-qkernel-202603","target":"redwood-v2-fp16-202602"}'`
Jordan: rollback started at 1768123560, ETA ~4m.
Sasha: I'll grep KV logs for SLA-IDs in last 6h: `gzcat /var/log/kvcache/*.gz | grep "SLATE" | grep 17680` and post anomalies.
Emma: Also please run a controlled eval comparing int4 vs fp16 on a 500-sample subset with identical request params (temperature, top_p, max_tokens=128). Use the same batching config.
Kai: noted. I'll kick that job and tag results here. job id: eval-1768123605
eval-bot: scheduled eval job eval-1768123605 (500 samples) on redwood-v2-int4-qkernel-202603 vs redwood-v2-fp16-202602
Jordan: rollback complete at 1768123665. Traffic restored to fp16 for SLATE.
Sasha: preliminary KV grep shows ~120 requests with `kvcache_miss=true` and 30 with `kvcache_partial=true` during 02:05-02:15 UTC. Correlates with qkernel rollout window.
Emma: initial severity: amber -> owner: @Jordan (routing/rollback), secondary owner: @Sasha (kvcache trace), QA owner: @Kai (eval job + promptset checks).
Kai: Agreed. Next steps: 1) wait for eval job results, 2) run quick regressions on a handful of failing prompts with different batching/window settings, 3) block qkernel auto-rollout until we have a root cause.
Jordan: I'll add an emergency guard in the rollout service to prevent auto-expansion of canaries until manual ack.
Emma: thanks. please capture the failing prompt ids and add to the regression suite. Also schedule a postmortem if eval confirms regression.
Kai: copying list of first 5 failing prompt ids from eval logs: SLT-00421, SLT-00487, SLT-00502, SLT-00533, SLT-00601
Sasha: saving KV traces and uploading to /mnt/share/triage/SLATE/1768123456_kv.tar.gz
Jordan: added rollout guard at 1768123690 and alerted infra on-call.
Kai: good work team — leave tickets and we'll reconvene after eval-1768123605 finishes. :thumbsup:
